member.summary: Picks the mask with the highest score, per ISO/IEC 18004 section 7.8.3.2.

member.remarks: This is a score, not a penalty: Micro QR selects the mask with the highest value, which is the opposite of the standard QR rule in . The score favours dark modules along the right and lower edges.
